description: This source file defines custom matchers for OpenMRS objects, facilitating unit testing with Hamcrest matchers. It includes matchers for matching IDs, UUIDs, and concepts within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: OpenmrsMatchers
classes.description: Contains static methods for creating custom Hamcrest matchers for OpenMRS objects, such as matching by ID, UUID, and Concept.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Returns a matcher that compares the ID of an OpenMRS object to the specified ID.

methods.name: hasUuid
methods.description: Returns a matcher that compares the UUID of an OpenMRS object to the specified UUID.

methods.name: hasConcept
methods.description: Returns a matcher that compares the Concept within a ConceptSearchResult to a given Concept matcher.
